scope: User-directed section 3 prerequisite study; keep section 2 speed gate failed/open. No tomato cutting, separation, robot motion, training or experimental-validation claims.
versions: v05 and original production checkpoint6925 stay unchanged. Any material/contact correction is a separately identified model candidate, never a retroactive pass.
preflight: Before a long hold, test material force under rigid rotations and superposed rotations using an independent double constitutive calculation. Require zero rest-force norm <=1e-9N and relative force-covariance error <=1e-8 with 1e-9N floor. A failure blocks dynamics with that constitutive candidate pending an explicit correction decision.

settling_if_preflight_passes.method: Accurate slower v05 IMEX route; not the rejected fast graph prototype
settling_if_preflight_passes.conditional_refinement: Only if stable and settled, refine dt once for the full hold; position <=0.1mm, material force and support reaction <=5% with declared1e-6N floor. Neither hold qualifies fracture or blade contact.

independent_preparation: Offline audit of finite-board placement, exact original blade geometry, cut topology and per-step fracture-law time dependence may proceed while a prerequisite blocks dynamics. Such work is not a dynamic contact or prepared-assembly pass.
contact_gate: No indentation unless settled supported target and checked original-blade contact adapter exist. Do not silently substitute analytic SDF, delete ties, retune viscosity or change original skin/cohesion calibration claims.
stopping: Report each of five checks as verified, failed, untested or decision-blocked. Ask only for a genuine material-law/representation decision. Preserve all failures.

approved_material_correction.formula: Ic=sum(F_ij^2) over all9 entries, per Smith/deGoes/Kim. Preserve diagonal-only failure separately.
approved_material_correction.requalification: Independent energy-force directional derivatives, static rigid rotation, force covariance, prior translation/freefall/oscillator/reset and small-signal controls, new corrected-law20ms explicit/refined/IMEX comparison under the original0.1mm/5% limits before a long hold. Do not reuse old-law dynamics as the accuracy reference.
